capabilities: Focus the file explorer on a single folder and hide the rest
Save folders as Spaces that open as sidebar tabs with their own file trees
Group multiple folders into one Space as labelled sections
Set custom Space icons from Lucide or Iconify
Create, rename, delete and drag files inside Space trees
extras: Compatibility notes warn that plugins injecting into the native explorer (e.g. per-folder icon plugins) will not show their additions inside Spaces, and CSS snippets targeting the explorer by data-type need an extra selector.
intentEvidence: Folder Space reimplements these as an independent, lightweight plugin with no dependency on either.
motivation: The author built it to preserve two features people loved — Folder Focus Mode's focusing and make.md's Spaces — as a maintained, standalone plugin without adopting make.md's whole ecosystem.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows the whole vault at once, and the plugins that offered folder focusing or saved folder panels are abandoned or bundled into a larger ecosystem.

relations.evidence: The focus capability of Folder Focus Mode, rebuilt and maintained.
The saved Spaces panel of make.md, extracted into a standalone, lightweight plugin.

summary: File explorer add-on that focuses the explorer on one folder and saves folders as sidebar tabs with their own file trees.
